svg.title: One message from send to delivered, and what a failure at each point costs
svg.desc: A timeline with six events: Alice taps send, the server stores the message, Alice sees one tick, the server pushes to Bob, Bob acknowledges, Alice sees two ticks. Amber: the message exists only on Alice's phone. Blue: it is in Bob's inbox on the server. Green: it is on Bob's phone. Three red crosses mark failures and their outcomes.
svg.text: one message, and what each failure costs
